articles.title: EU securities regulator gives crypto platforms 3 months to remove unauthorized stablecoins
articles.snippet: ESMA said authorized platforms must block new access to stablecoins that fail to meet MiCA rules, while national authorities oversee existing customer holdings.

articles.title: ESMA gives crypto firms 3 months to exit non-compliant stablecoins
articles.snippet: ESMA said EU crypto firms should halt services involving non-MiCA-compliant stablecoins, giving regulators three months to address existing exposures.

articles.title: Standard Chartered plans institutional crypto custody in Singapore
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered plans custody for cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and tokenized assets for institutional and eligible corporate clients in Singapore.

articles.title: Circle brings USDC, EURC payments to SAP customers through Tereina
articles.snippet: The partnership with SAP-backed Tereina will let businesses send and receive Circle’s stablecoins from within the financial software they already use.

articles.title: Tether, Kazakhstan cenbank mull tenge stablecoin and asset tokenization
articles.snippet: The agreement will explore a tenge-backed stablecoin pilot and a framework for tokenizing real-world assets as Kazakhstan expands its digital asset industry.
